description: Builds a scale from twelve switches and puts it out as pitches, one note per channel

params.text: Sets the note the scale is built on, C to B
Sets the octave the scale starts in, -4 to 4
While on, the base note itself is part of the scale
While on, the note one semitone above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note two semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note three semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note four semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note five semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note six semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note seven semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note eight semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note nine semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note ten semitones above the base is part of the scale
While on, the note eleven semitones above the base is part of the scale

inputs.text: Sets the twelve switches from a cable, one channel per semitone counting up from the base; a channel above 1V switches its note on and the switches move to match

outputs.text: The notes of the scale as pitch, one per channel, rising from the base note and carrying on into the octaves above once the twelve are used up

notes: with no switch on, nothing is written and the output holds whatever it last carried
a note that would pass 10V is not written, so the channels above it keep older values
menu: Polyphonic Channels — sets how many notes the output carries, 1 to 16
